title: Repo skeleton: npm workspaces, lint, CI skeleton, MIT license
acceptance: npm install && npm test --workspaces succeed on an empty skeleton
GitLab pipeline runs lint + test stages green
LICENSE (MIT) at repo root and detected by GitLab

title: k3d cluster script with local registry and *.localtest.me ingress
acceptance: scripts/cluster-up.sh creates the cluster idempotently
A test nginx Ingress answers on http://test.localtest.me
Secrets are created from gitignored .env.local

title: Helm chart: MariaDB + WordPress with PVCs, probes, limits, Ingress
acceptance: helm lint passes
http://store.localtest.me loads WordPress
Deleting the WordPress and MariaDB pods keeps content (PVC)
Every workload has probes and requests/limits

title: Store bootstrap Job: install WooCommerce, enable COD, create Application Password into a Secret
acceptance: Fresh install ends with WooCommerce active and COD enabled
Application Password stored only in a Kubernetes Secret
REST call to /wp-json/wc/v3/orders with that password returns 200
D1 manual checkout works and the order shows in admin

title: Contracts: gateway HTTP API, MCP endpoint, DB schema, tool naming, error envelope
acceptance: packages/contracts exports typed API, error envelope, qualified-name helpers
DB schema (users, sessions, api_keys, upstreams, audit_log) as a migration
ADR 001 records the decisions
Aadi approves (G1)

title: woo-mcp server scaffold: Streamable HTTP, shared-secret auth, healthz, WooCommerce client
acceptance: tools/list works over Streamable HTTP
Requests without the shared secret get 401
Woo client has 10 s timeouts and maps errors to the envelope

title: woo-mcp tools: list_products, create_product
acceptance: Unit tests for schema, happy path, 404/401/timeout
Against the cluster: create_product then list_products returns it

title: woo-mcp tools: list_orders (date filter, Asia/Kolkata), get_order, update_order_status
acceptance: list_orders date=today returns an order placed today
update_order_status rejects unknown statuses
Unit tests for every tool

title: woo-mcp in the chart: ClusterIP, no Ingress, NetworkPolicy gateway-only
acceptance: A curl pod without the gateway label cannot reach woo-mcp
The gateway pod can
No Ingress exists for woo-mcp

title: Postgres in the chart + gateway migrations and seed admin
acceptance: Migrations run on gateway start
Initial admin created from a Secret
Data survives pod deletion

title: Gateway upstream registry: CRUD, encrypted credentials, SSRF guard
acceptance: Admin can add/edit/disable/remove upstreams
Credential never returned by any API
SSRF tests: metadata IP, loopback, private ranges blocked unless allow-listed

title: Gateway aggregation, routing, collision naming, timeouts, health checks
acceptance: Two fake upstreams with the same tool name both callable via qualified names
A slow upstream does not delay listing beyond 3 s
A dead upstream is marked down and its tools hidden

title: Users, roles, sessions; API keys (show once, SHA-256, revoke)
acceptance: Admin can create members and roles
Key shown once, stored hashed
Revoked key rejected on next call

title: Gateway external MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP) with API-key auth
acceptance: MCP Inspector connects with URL + key and lists tools
Calls route through callTool
Missing/invalid/revoked key → 401

title: Audit log in callTool + audit API with filters
acceptance: Every call writes user, server, tool, timestamp, duration, outcome
Members see own rows, admins see all
No raw arguments or results stored

title: Upstreams 2 and 3: server-everything in cluster + GitLab MCP (fallback: public no-auth server)
acceptance: Three upstreams listed and healthy
Decision on GitLab MCP auth recorded in an ADR
Deleting the server-everything pod shows it down while others work

title: Dashboard: login, upstreams (status, tools), members, my keys, audit pages
acceptance: Admin and member see role-appropriate pages
Upstream status refreshes every 15 s
Credential values never appear in the browser (checked in network tab)

title: Dashboard chat agent: Claude tool loop via callTool, shows tools used
acceptance: Chat creates a product and lists today's orders
Each tool call shown in the UI and audited under the session user
Claude key only in a Secret, never sent to the browser

title: E2E scripts D1–D8 (tests/e2e/run.sh)
acceptance: ./tests/e2e/run.sh all prints PASS for D1–D8 twice in a row

title: CHECKPOINT: D1–D8 pass on a fresh cluster
acceptance: cluster-up + helm install + run.sh all from scratch passes
Aadi reruns it and confirms

title: Pipeline: build images to GitLab registry, Helm package, Secret Detection, SAST, IaC, container scans
acceptance: Main pipeline pushes tagged images and a versioned chart
All scan jobs run and report
Pipeline history visible on the public project

title: Canary deploy of the gateway + verdict.py (business health through the gateway)
acceptance: Canary receives a slice of traffic
verdict.py outputs PROMOTE/ROLLBACK/HOLD from error rate, latency and woo__list_orders success
A forced bad release rolls back automatically

title: Duo flows: Verdict, Incident (opens regression issue), risk gate (Human Input)
acceptance: One forced rollback in pipeline history creates an incident + priority::high regression issue
An auth/gateway MR pauses for human approval before promote
Flow YAML committed in .gitlab/flows/

title: VPS values + deploy with the same chart
acceptance: helm install with values-prod.yaml on the VPS
Public URL live

title: Docs: DESIGN.md, THREAT_MODEL.md, README with setup and local-to-VPS story
acceptance: README gets a new machine from zero to D1–D8
Threat model covers SSRF, malicious tool descriptions, compromised upstream, key leak
Design note explains store connectivity choice (W4) and naming scheme (G3)
